meta.name: Debi
meta.description:
When an aspiring actress is murdered, an underestimated police constable uncovers a chilling conspiracy between a revered god-man and a grieving mother, only to realize the mastermind is hiding under her own roof.

Not complete. On your server: S1 1/5 (missing E2-5)

videos.title: Antardhan
videos.overview: Sneha, an ambitious aspiring actress, mysteriously vanishes. While the official police investigation hits a dead end, Debi, a determined but overlooked female constable, begins her own search.
